summary: Full regression on Orison School Mgmt: backend student validation (422/200/409), bulk CSV dedup, analytics endpoints; frontend Add Student inline validation (no alerts), duplicate admission inline error, role-based Access Denied for Fee Manager and Principal, sidebar 'Promote Student' spelling and submenu-open behavior, dashboards render real numbers with no em-dash placeholders. Everything passed.

issues: Greeting shows 'Welcome back, Fee' instead of 'Welcome back, Fee Manager' — likely splitting name on first space

action_items: (Minor) Fee Manager dashboard greeting only shows 'Fee' instead of 'Fee Manager' — check name split logic in Dashboard/Layout header.

(Data hygiene) DELETE /api/students/{id} does NOT cascade-delete the auto-created fee record in db.fees. Consider cascading or you'll accumulate orphan fee rows (visible on Fee Manager 'Top Outstanding Dues').
critical_code_review_comments: server.py delete_student() does not delete the associated fee document created in create_student() — orphaned fee records accumulate.
REQUIRED_STUDENT_FIELDS validation is done post-Pydantic; consider using Pydantic Field(min_length=1) for stronger typing. Not blocking.
server.py at ~700 lines is getting large — consider splitting routes into modules (students.py, fees.py, analytics.py) per project guideline.
CORS allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True is invalid per spec (browsers ignore credentials). Tighten origins for production.
test_credentials: Role buttons: Login as Admin / Login as principal / Login as Fee Manager (POST /api/auth/login {role})
seed_data_creation: Test students/fees created during tests were cleaned up (5 orphan fee docs + all TEST_ students deleted at end).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest+xdist, 10 tests, ~3s). They create TEST_ prefixed students and delete them; bulk test may leave orphan fee docs — cleanup script snippet at end of iteration_1 report cleans by name regex ^TEST_. Frontend flows verified: role login buttons, /students/add/new inline validation (data-testid=add-student-error-<field>, add-student-save-btn), duplicate 409 -> inline admission_no error, /students/promote submenu opens (sidebar 'Promote Student'), role Access Denied works for fee_manager (/marks/add, /teachers) and principal (/fee). Admin menu is unrestricted (menu=null).
rca of the issue: N/A — all reported production-blocking bugs are resolved.
